sql_templates.name: SectorBreadthRotationQuery
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_breadth AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.sector_daily WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)),
latest_stage AS (SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) AND stage = 'STAGE_2' AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY'))
SELECT b.sector, COUNT(s.symbol) AS stage2_count
FROM latest_breadth b
JOIN latest_stage s ON b.sector = s.sector
GROUP BY b.sector
ORDER BY stage2_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
